title: Combinatorial sputtering of photoluminescent europium titanium oxide thin films
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27415-27428
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04076K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Junfeng Chen, Jeff Rao, Adrianus Indrat Aria
Photoluminescent thin films were fabricated using a combinatorial physical vapour deposition (PVD) process, enabling rapid variation of europium oxide (Eu2O3) in titanium dioxide (TiO2) with concentrations varying from x = 0–1 in x = Eu/(Eu + Ti).
